description: Java interface defining the contract for sending HTML emails, including methods for sending emails and setting email configuration.

classes.name: HtmlEmailSender
classes.description: Interface for sending HTML emails with methods to send emails and configure email settings.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an email using the provided Email object. May throw an exception.

methods.name: setEmailConfig
methods.description: Sets the email configuration settings using the provided EmailConfig object.
